name: Stochastic Volume Rendering of Multi-Phase SPH Data
definition: A novel method for direct volume rendering of large smoothed-particle hydrodynamics (SPH) simulation data that avoids transforming unstructured data to an intermediate representation. It addresses computational complexity by considering only a subset of particles at each step during ray marching, with sample probabilities determined by view-dependent factors and spatial complexity of the data.
summary: Stochastic Volume Rendering of Multi-Phase SPH Data is a direct rendering technique that stochastically samples SPH particles during ray marching to avoid grid representations and handle multi-phase interfaces.
